cases.name: conversion result has declared numeric representation

steps.source: class S{operator uint8(){return 7;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8);

cases.name: dynamic range failure at operator return

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=257;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n:uint8=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: explicit cast selects operator but keeps return checked

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=257;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n=raw:=uint8;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: fallthrough result is checked

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n:uint8=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: finite recursive conversion result chain

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=calls<3?new S():7;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=7;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();function f():uint8{return raw;}const n=f();String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;

cases.name: checked result at type call

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=7;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n=uint8(raw);String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;

cases.name: checked result at field

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=7;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();class H{n:uint8=raw;}const n=new H().n;String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;

cases.name: explicit any return annotation does not erase target

cases.name: wrong dynamic kind is refused

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any="7";return x;}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n:uint8=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: typed-width mismatch is not implicitly widened

steps.source: class S{operator uint16(){const x:any=7:=uint8;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n:uint16=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e;

cases.name: explicit conversion inside body may discard information

steps.source: class S{operator uint8(){const x:any=257;return x:=uint8;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n)+"/"+String(n is uint8);

cases.name: selected body throw retains original failure

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;throw new Error("body");}}const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{const n:uint8=raw;}catch(err){e=err.message;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: finally effects precede dynamic result admission

steps.source: let log="";class S{operator uint8(){try{const x:any=257;return x;}finally{log+="f";}}}const raw:any=new S();try{const n:uint8=raw;}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

cases.name: failed result preserves destination and user effects

steps.source: let calls=0;class S{operator uint8(){calls++;const x:any=257;return x;}}let n:uint8=3;const raw:any=new S();let e="";try{n=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+String(n)+"/"+calls;

cases.name: body may catch a failed nested conversion and recover

steps.source: let calls=0;class Bad{operator uint8(){const x:any=257;return x;}}class Good{operator uint8(){calls++;const bad:any=new Bad();try{const n:uint8=bad;}catch(e){}return 7;}}const raw:any=new Good();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;

cases.name: alias target resolves in declaration scope

steps.source: type T=uint8;class S{operator T(){const x:any=7;return x;}}function use(){type T=boolean;const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;return String(n is uint8);}use();

cases.name: enclosing generic capture resolves after escape

steps.source: function make<T:type>(){return class S{operator T(){const x:any=7;return x;}};}const S=make.<uint8>();const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8);

cases.name: value parameter target retains extent

steps.source: class S<N:uint32>{operator uint.<N>(){const x:any=7;return x;}}const raw:any=new S.<8>();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8);

cases.name: tuple result converts and protects elements

steps.source: class S{operator [uint8,string](){const x:any=[7,"s"];return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:[uint8,string]=raw;let e="";try{const x:any=n;x[0]=257;}catch(err){e=err.name;}String(n[0] is uint8)+"/"+e;

cases.name: array result converts every element

steps.source: class S{operator [].<uint8>(){const x:any=[7,8];return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:[].<uint8>=raw;String(n[0] is uint8)+"/"+String(n[1] is uint8);

cases.name: nominal nonmember does not invoke inbound retry

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:any){log+="i";return new C();}}class S{operator C(){log+="s";const x:any={};return x;}}const raw:any=new S();try{const c:C=raw;}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

cases.name: value-class inbound result is copied

steps.source: class P{x:uint8=1;operator P(v:boolean){return saved;}}let saved:any=new P();const raw:any=true;const result:P=raw;result.x=9;String(saved.x)+"/"+String(result.x);

cases.name: metadata result is transported at declared return

steps.source: type D={r:number};meta D{default={r:1};subtype(a,b){return true;}conversionFactor(a,b){return a.r/b.r;}}type A=float64.<{r:2}>;type B=float64.<{r:1}>;class S{operator B(){const x:any=3:=A;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:B=raw;String(n)+"/"+String(n is B);

steps.source: type D={r:number};meta D{default={r:1};subtype(a,b){return true;}conversionFactor(a,b){return a.r/b.r;}}type A=float64.<{r:2}>;type B=float64.<{r:1}>;class S{operator B(){const x:any=3:=A;return x;}}const raw:any=new S();const n=raw:=B;String(n)+"/"+String(n is B);

cases.name: explicit reference cannot satisfy ordinary value result

steps.source: let location:uint8=7;class S{operator uint8(){return ref location;}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8)+"/"+String(location);

cases.name: ordinary named operator behavior is unchanged

steps.source: class S{operator +(v:number):number{return v+1;}}String(new S()+2);

cases.name: primitive named operator behavior is unchanged

steps.source: primitive float64{operator *(v:string):string{return v;}}(1:=float64)*"ok";

cases.name: undefined admitting target can fall through

steps.source: type Maybe=uint8|undefined;class S{operator Maybe(){}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8|undefined=raw;String(n===undefined);

steps.source: function f():uint8{return 7;}function f():string{return "s";}class S{operator uint8(){return f();}}const raw:any=new S();const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8);

const n:uint8=raw;String(n is uint8)+"/"+calls;
